description:
Clean up the TailwindTraders Git repository by deleting all stale branches. The repository currently has 8 branches. You must delete the 5 stale branches (both merged and abandoned) while strictly preserving the 3 active branches.

**Branches to DELETE:**
- `feature/search-api` (Merged)
- `feature/user-auth` (Merged)
- `bugfix/price-calc` (Merged)
- `feature/old-dashboard` (Abandoned)
- `feature/experimental-cache` (Abandoned)

**Branches to KEEP:**
- `main`
- `develop`
- `release/v1.0`

Navigate to the Azure DevOps Repos > Branches view for the TailwindTraders repository and perform the cleanup.
